articles.title: PolinRider Malware Returns in 10 Hijacked npm Packages Using Ethereum Blockchain to Deliver Malicious Code
articles.summary:
A concealed JavaScript loaders in 12 releases across 10 hijacked npm packages, linking the compromise to previously documented PolinRider activity. Investigated on November 4, 2026, the releases use Ethereum transactions to discover remote payload servers and execute downloaded code inside developer environments, build systems, or applications. articles.title: SonicWall Warns of Actively Exploited SSL-VPN Vulnerability That Bypasses SAML and MFA Protection
articles.summary:
SonicWall has urged customers to address an SSL-VPN authentication vulnerability that can bypass SAML controls, including associated multifactor authentication measures. This issue is tracked as CVE-2026-19868 and affects SonicOS deployments that utilize SAML for SSL-VPN logins. The company has investigated reports suggesting potential exploitation but has not confirmed a widespread attack campaign in its advisory. […]

The post SonicWall Warns of Actively Exploited SSL-VPN Vulnerability That Bypasses SAML and MFA Protection appeared first on GBHackers Security | #1 Globally Trusted Cyber Security News Platform.

articles.title: Critical React Server Components Vulnerability Allows Unauthenticated Attackers to Execute Malicious Code on Servers
articles.summary:
A serious vulnerability in React Server Components may enable unauthenticated attackers to execute malicious code on affected servers. The advisory, released on October 14, 2026, assigns the issue a CVSS v4.0 score of 9.5. React maintainers advise that users update their systems immediately, though they emphasize that the conditions necessary for exploitation are extremely rare. […]

articles.title: Anthropic’s Claude AI Deletes a Year of Law Professor’s Lecture Notes During Simple Editing Task
articles.summary:

articles.title: NotC2 AI-Powered Hacking Tool Turns Amazon Bedrock Into a Cloud Command-and-Control System
articles.summary:

articles.title: ArmorSteal Malware Steals Passwords and Crypto Wallet Data, Hides Mining When Task Manager Opens
articles.summary:
